text:
mike: Heads up — after the kernel-selector rollout last night we're seeing a correlated drop in batch_util and tokens/sec on xg-rt-kernel-v2. Not huge latency spike, but throughput regression that hurts p50 token/sec for small requests :eyes:

perf-bot: automated snapshot (window=10m):
```
time_bucket | batch_util | tokens_per_sec | qdepth_p95 | kv_miss_rate
23:10       | 0.78 -> 0.32 | 820 -> 310     | 1 -> 12    | 0.02 -> 0.11
```

ana: @mike can you share the trace IDs or a quick flame? I want to see if the kernel itself is slower or if queueing changed the effective batch shapes.

sophie: dashboard: https://redwood.dash/g/rt/batching?panel=kernel_queue (private) — looking at per-kernel queue age: p95 jumped from 12ms to 140ms around the deploy. Also KV cache miss rate rises line up with the same window. Could be eviction timing + kernel selection causing micro-bursts.

raj: Re: rollout — we changed kernel selection to favor fused-kernel when avg_seq_len < 32 and expected_batch_size >= 6. If effective batch formation is getting smaller (due to higher queue churn), fused-kernel might be starving batching and increasing per-request overhead. Suggest fallback policy: if observed batch_util < 0.5 for 60s, prefer conservative kernel.

mike: grabbing a sample flame and a few batch traces now. run this on prod-trace exporter:
```
curl -sS 'https://trace-api/redwood/profiles?start=1759999400&end=1759999999&filter=kernel:xg-rt-kernel-v2' | jq .items[0].flamegraph > /tmp/fg.svg
```

ana: also can we add per-batch token distribution to telemetry? Right now we only record avg batch size. Need histograms for tokens-per-batch and batch-age (time between first enqueue -> dispatch).

sophie: yeah will add panels: per-kernel batch_size_hist, tokens_per_batch_p50/95/99, queue_wait_ms_p50/95, kv_miss_rate_by_kernel. Can do a first pass in the next 4h, deploy to staging.

raj: we should also correlate kernel selection logs (which kernel was chosen) with observed batch shapes. If selector picks fused while queue depth < 3, that's a bad signal. Add a quick tag in telemetry: selector_reason and chosen_kernel.

ops-bot: created issue INF-4239 "kernel-selector telemetry + fallback policy" and linked runbook.

mike: action items: 
- [ ] sophie: add dashboard panels (batch_size_hist, tokens_per_batch, queue_wait_ms) — ETA 4h
- [ ] ana: run flame sample + compare kernel latency (hj) — ETA 1h
- [ ] raj: draft fallback rule (batch_util threshold -> conservative kernel) and add selector_reason tag — ETA 2h
- [x] ops-bot: ticket INF-4239 created

mike: if anyone sees sustained token/sec drop after fixes, ping me and we'll rollback selector. For now priority = telemetry + conservative fallback. Thanks :thumbsup:
